newsitem.title: CHINA: ATHLETICS-CHINA PROMISES CASH PRIZES TO GOLD MEDALLISTS.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-CHINA PROMISES CASH PRIZES TO GOLD MEDALLISTS.

text.p: Chinese athletes have been offered big cash incentives for winning gold medals or breaking world records at the world championships beginning in Athens on Saturday.
The Beijing Youth Daily said on Friday athletes who won gold would be paid 300,000 yuan ($36,000) while a world record-breaker would pocket 700,000 yuan.

The prizes were the highest offered by the China Athletic Association and were almost as generous as those offered by the Chinese Olympic Committee, it quoted the State Physical Cultural and Sports Commission as saying.
